d: Short, chestnut brown hair with choppy layers and long bangs swept across the forehead. Bright sapphire blue eyes with a gentle, youthful expression on a face appearing to be in the early teens. A slender, petite build wearing a navy blue sleeveless tunic over a white long-sleeved shirt, paired with short blue trousers, a brown leather belt with a gold buckle, and dark brown lace-up boots. A dark brown hooded cloak is draped over the shoulders, accented by a cluster of vibrant cyan feathers on the right side, while a brown leather pouch and a quiver of arrows are attached to the hip and back.
